confirm.desc: Confirm / start - use on menus, title screen, dialogues.

jump_forward.desc: Jump while running forward (gaps, springs, enemies).

stomp.desc: Stomp / quick drop (also ground-pound near ledges).

wait.desc: Do nothing briefly (let a cutscene or transition play).

goal: Play Sonic Unleashed. Get through the level: run forward along the path, jump over gaps and obstacles, boost on straightaways when the gauge allows, drift on sharp corners, grab rings. If a menu/title/dialogue is on screen, press confirm to advance. If a cutscene is playing, wait.
name: Sonic Unleashed
rules: Pick exactly one action per tick.
Prefer run_forward when the path ahead is clear.
Use jump_forward for gaps, springs, and ramps - never run off an edge.
On menus or 'press start' screens, use confirm.
